au_abs_c21_g02_lga.dataset: Census of Population and Housing 2021, General Community Profile G02 'Selected medians and averages', by Local Government Area (ASGS 2021); MEDAVG 4 = median total household income ($/weekly), 5 = median mortgage repayment ($/monthly), 6 = median rent ($/weekly)
au_abs_c21_g02_lga.url_mirror: none - fetched directly from the ABS Data API via WebFetch on 2026-10-17; transcriptions saved in _raw/abs_api/g02_lga_state*.txt (+ verify_g02_subset.txt)
au_abs_c21_g02_lga.period: 2021 (Census night 10 Aug 2021; incomes are 2021 weekly amounts)
au_abs_c21_g02_lga.notes: 556 LGA-level areas incl. 'No usual address'/'Migratory' pseudo-areas (codes x9399/x9799, never joined). Places joined by point-in-polygon on ABS ASGS 2016 LGA boundaries (npm which-boundary 0.2.0, data/lga.geobuf, built from ABS 1270055003_lga_2016_aust_shape; coordinates are 1e6-scaled integers) and matched to 2021 data by LGA code; 2016 codes that no longer exist in 2021 (e.g. 18230, 10130, 14200, 13510, 43920) are left missing. A value of 0 (suppressed/not applicable) was dropped.

ca_statcan_cp2021_cd.dataset: Census Profile, 2021 Census of Population, census divisions (dataflow STC_CP:DF_CD). Characteristics: 229 Median total income of household in 2020 ($); 1474 Median value of dwellings ($); 1480 Median monthly shelter costs for rented dwellings ($); 2230 Unemployment rate; 2024 Bachelor's degree or higher (population aged 25-64 in private households), STATISTIC 4 = rate (%)
ca_statcan_cp2021_cd.url_mirror: none - fetched directly from the StatCan Census Profile SDMX API via WebFetch on 2026-10-17; transcriptions in _raw/statcan_cp2021/cd_*.txt (+ verify_subset1.txt). Join geometry: StatCan 2016 census division boundaries as packaged in R package mapcan (github.com/mccormackandrew/mapcan data/census_divisions_2016.rda, commit c4dafefa04c6321af479a474ca2a6cafa041aa9f, EPSG:3978, Statistics Canada Open Licence)
ca_statcan_cp2021_cd.notes: All 293 CDs; 2016 and 2021 CD code sets are identical (293/293). Characteristic ids were identified by querying DF_PR for Ontario (e.g. 229 = 'Median total income of household in 2020 ($)' = 91,000 for Ontario; 2024 rate 36.8 = 2,789,795/7,584,645). Unemployment rate refers to the Census reference week (May 2021, pandemic period).

us_acs5_2023_datacensusgov.dataset: American Community Survey 2019-2023 5-year estimates: B25077_001E Median value (dollars) of owner-occupied housing units; B25064_001E Median gross rent (dollars), counties
us_acs5_2023_datacensusgov.url_mirror: none - data.census.gov access API via WebFetch on 2026-10-17 (api.census.gov now refuses requests without a key); transcriptions in _raw/census_data_api/b25077_us_p0.txt, b25064_us_p0.txt (+ verify_*.txt)
us_acs5_2023_datacensusgov.notes: PARTIAL: the fetcher truncates the all-county response, so only states FIPS 01-24 (home value; GA 13321 dropped by transcription) and 01-26 (rent) are delivered; later states omitted rather than partially filled. Suppressed values (-666666666) dropped.

us_acs5_2023_b15001_chr_mirror.dataset: American Community Survey 2019-2023 5-year, table B15001 (sex by age by educational attainment), counties; derived share = (B15001_017+018+025+026+058+059+066+067)/(B15001_011+019+052+060) = bachelor's degree or higher among persons 25-44
us_acs5_2023_b15001_chr_mirror.url_mirror: https://github.com/countyhealthrankings/county_health_measure_calculations raw_data/ACS/acs_data_2019-2023.zip (acs_data_2019-2023.csv, unmodified ACS API pull), commit e1e1c825059b5b260b4766d75f8449e3c7e7587d
us_acs5_2023_b15001_chr_mirror.notes: Ratio of official counts (no modelling). Age band 25-44 only because the mirror carries B15001 for those ages; not the usual 25+ share. Mirror tied to the official release: B19013_001E in the same file equals the previously verified world_places median household income for all 21,091 joined places.
